title: Songs of Praise Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Songs of Praise Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Psalms Bible crossword: Psalm 100, the songs of ascents, Miriam’s song and the Magnificat. KJV clues, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: The Bible's songs are older than its books of law, and they turn up everywhere — Miriam with a timbrel at the sea, Deborah under her palm tree, Hannah in the temple, Mary in Elisabeth's house. Songs of Praise gathers the songs themselves rather than the subject of worship, with the Psalter at its centre.
It sits in the Medium tier because it asks you to place a song with its singer. The closing verse is the opening line of the shortest and most-sung psalm of them all.

clues.text: She took a timbrel and sang after the Red Sea
“Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye ___”

verseText: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.
